poe 1
# A maintenance announcer: personality for a tiny obstacle yard, no campaign.
response yard.welcome
 event arrive
 speaker pa
 category yard
 text Relay Yard test track. The stairs are certified. Your shortcuts are not.
 priority 1
 cooldown 90
 repeat once
endresponse
response yard.cell
 event pickup
 speaker pa
 category yard
 text One working cell. Already above the yard average.
 when inventory.cells >= 1
 priority 3
 cooldown 90
 repeat once
endresponse
response yard.open
 event gate
 speaker pa
 category yard
 text Bridge powered. Please reserve the victory lap for the far side.
 when gate.open == true
 priority 5
 cooldown 90
 repeat once
endresponse
response yard.finish
 event finish
 speaker pa
 category yard
 text Clean crossing. The clipboard is impressed. Quietly.
 when course.finished == true
 priority 6
 cooldown 90
 repeat once
endresponse

raw.poe:
poe 1
# Short interaction: the cell and bridge are actual gameplay state.
response light.callback
 event finish
 speaker mara
 category callback
 text You kept no spare, but the bridge is holding. I'll take that trade.
 when gate.open == true
 when course.finished == true
 priority 7
 cooldown 120
 repeat once
endresponse
scene light.offer
 node offer
  speaker mara
  text One cell left. The bridge can use it. You can keep it. Your call.
  choice share consequential -> thanks | Put the cell in the bridge.
   when inventory.cells >= 1
   when gate.open == false
   do bridge.power true
  endchoice
  choice keep expressive -> end | Keep it. I need a moment.
  endchoice
 endnode
 node thanks
  speaker mara
  text There. Follow the rail across. I'll watch the contacts.
  next end
 endnode
endscene
